variables.input:
timeseries avg(node_uname_info), by: { cluster_name }
| fields cluster_name

timeseries avg(node_uname_info, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster_name }), by: { `service.instance.id` }

timeseries avg(node_disk_io_time_seconds_total), by: { device }

0.content: **Host View**: The operating system alone: CPU, memory, disk I/O and network per host. A tile's description shows its equivalent Prometheus query.

2.title: Node Exporter UP (total)

3.title: CPU Cores (total)
3.description:
Equivalent Prometheus query:
sum( count by (instance) (count by (cpu, instance) (node_cpu_seconds_total{job="$job",cluster_name="$cluster_name"}) ))

4.title: CPU Cores
4.description:
Equivalent Prometheus query:
 min(count by (instance) (count by (cpu, instance) (node_cpu_seconds_total{}) ))
 avg(count by (instance) (count by (cpu, instance) (node_cpu_seconds_total{}) ))
 max(count by (instance) (count by (cpu, instance) (node_cpu_seconds_total{}) ))

5.title: Total Memory (bytes)
5.query:
timeseries a0 = min(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster_name }), a1 = avg(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster_name }), a2 = max(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster_name })
| fieldsAdd min = a0[], avg = a1[], max = a2[]
| fieldsRemove a0, a1, a2
| fields min = coalesce(min[-2], arrayLast(min)), avg = coalesce(avg[-2], arrayLast(avg)), max = coalesce(max[-2], arrayLast(max))

6.title: File Descriptor (allocated)
6.query:
timeseries a0 = min(node_filefd_allocated, filter: { in(`service.instance.id`, array($node)) and cluster_name == $cluster_name }), a1 = avg(node_filefd_allocated, filter: { in(`service.instance.id`, array($node)) and cluster_name == $cluster_name }), a2 = max(node_filefd_allocated, filter: { in(`service.instance.id`, array($node)) and cluster_name == $cluster_name })
| fieldsAdd min = a0[], avg = a1[], max = a2[]
| fieldsRemove a0, a1, a2
| fields min = coalesce(min[-2], arrayLast(min)), avg = coalesce(avg[-2], arrayLast(avg)), max = coalesce(max[-2], arrayLast(max))

7.content:
### % CPU Utilization (rate)

_Not available in Dynatrace yet (arithmetic between series grouped differently (a join)). The equivalent Prometheus query:_

```promql
 min(sum by( instance) (irate(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster_name",instance=~"$node", mode!="idle"}[$__rate_interval])) / scalar(sum ( irate(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster_name",instance=~"$node", }[$__rate_interval]) ))*100 ) 
 avg(sum by( instance) (irate(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster_name",instance=~"$node", mode!="idle"}[$__rate_interval])) / scalar(sum ( irate(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster_name",instance=~"$node", }[$__rate_interval]) ))*100 ) 
 max(sum by( instance) (irate(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster_name",instance=~"$node", mode!="idle"}[$__rate_interval])) / scalar(sum ( irate(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="$job", cluster_name="$cluster_name",instance=~"$node", }[$__rate_interval]) ))*100 ) 
```

11.title: Network Traffic - retransmit (packets) (total) (rate)
11.query:
timeseries a0 = avg(node_netstat_Tcp_RetransSegs, filter: { in(`service.instance.id`, array($node)) and cluster_name == $cluster_name }), by: { cluster_name, `service.instance.id` }
| fieldsAdd a0 = arrayDelta(a0)
| fieldsAdd a0 = a0[] / (interval / 1s)
| fieldsAdd value = a0[]
| fieldsRemove a0
| summarize value = sum(value[]), by: { timeframe, interval }
| fields value = coalesce(value[-2], arrayLast(value))

sum by (device) (irate(node_network_receive_bytes_total{job="$job",cluster_name="$cluster_name", instance=~"$node",}[$__rate_interval]))

20.content:
### % CPU Utilization (topk) (rate)

_Not available in Dynatrace yet (arithmetic between series grouped differently (a join)). The equivalent Prometheus query:_

```promql
topk($topk_limit, (sum by(cpu, instance) (irate(node_cpu_seconds_total{instance=~"$node",job="$job", mode!="idle",cluster_name="$cluster_name"}[$__rate_interval])) / on(instance) group_left sum by (instance)((irate(node_cpu_seconds_total{instance=~"$node",job="$job",cluster_name="$cluster_name"}[$__rate_interval])))) * 100)
```

sum by(instance) (irate(node_cpu_seconds_total{instance=~"$node",job="$job", mode=~".*irq"

23.title: Memory Page Faults (rate)
23.query:
timeseries a0 = avg(node_vmstat_pgfault, filter: { in(`service.instance.id`, array($node)) and cluster_name == $cluster_name }), a1 = avg(node_vmstat_pgmajfault, filter: { in(`service.instance.id`, array($node)) and cluster_name == $cluster_name }), a2 = avg(node_vmstat_pgfault, filter: { in(`service.instance.id`, array($node)) and cluster_name == $cluster_name }), a3 = avg(node_vmstat_pgmajfault, filter: { in(`service.instance.id`, array($node)) and cluster_name == $cluster_name }), by: { cluster_name, `service.instance.id` }
| fieldsAdd a0 = arrayDelta(a0)
| fieldsAdd a0 = a0[] / (interval / 1s)
| fieldsAdd a1 = arrayDelta(a1)
| fieldsAdd a1 = a1[] / (interval / 1s)
| fieldsAdd a2 = arrayDelta(a2)
| fieldsAdd a2 = a2[] / (interval / 1s)
| fieldsAdd a3 = arrayDelta(a3)
| fieldsAdd a3 = a3[] / (interval / 1s)
| fieldsAdd pgfault = a0[], pgmajfault = a1[], pgminfault = (a2[] - a3[])
| fieldsRemove a0, a1, a2, a3
